about: Framework of the new-project wizard (DECISIONS.md D-83): a base and the additions combined with it. Official instructions, versions checked on npm, Packagist and GitHub on 15/10/2026, those added on 19/10/2026 (D-131) also on PyPI, crates.io, proxy.golang.org, NuGet, JSR and CRAN. category: the group of a base in the wizard's tree (web-php, web-js, web-python, web-other, cms, docs, desktop, mobile, data, cli). Every web base with an interface of its own but the CMS and the documentation sites has the CSS frameworks (slot css); development goes through Vite or its equivalent (Turbopack for Next.js). env: variables written in .env before the steps ({name}, {package} filled in). database (of a base or of an addition): a server of the kit (mysql, mongodb) where the project gets its database, its connection written in .env, before the steps; the steps get it as $env:ATOLLO_DB_HOST, _PORT, _NAME, _USER, _PASSWORD, _URL, and the variables of .env too ({password} = a new password, DECISIONS.md D-93). Each line is one command run with the kit's PowerShell and environment: 'create' in projects\ (it makes the folder {name}), 'steps' inside projects\{name}. {name} = project name, as a PowerShell string in single quotes (never inside the code of another language), {package} = com.example.<name in lower case letters and digits>. needs: components of the kit, installed first. actions: name and command, saved as the project's actions as they are ({name} and {package} not filled in; cmd.exe on Windows, /bin/sh elsewhere: no PowerShell). No generator may init Git: a folder with .git is never used. An addition has one entry in 'on' per base it works with: its 'create' replaces the base's (a starter kit, a template), its steps come after the base's, its actions replace those of the base with the same name. Two additions of the same 'slot' do not go together. desc and note: Italian, translated by i18n/catalog.json.
